about: A2 (feat/pine-named-args-minmax, engine 84): a named argument on color.new / color.rgb / color.from_gradient / array.new_<type> / array.new<type> takes its declared position by Pine's own parameter name (the Pine v6 reference's syntax lines); an unknown name, a duplicate, a positional after a named one, or a skipped parameter keeps the refusal. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: no named argument is mapped at all
a parameter given twice is accepted (the later wins)
a positional argument after a named one is accepted
mutants.from: if (named) return null   // a positional argument after a named one
mutants.expectRed: positional argument after a named one

mutants.mutant: a skipped parameter is let through
mutants.from: for (let i = 0; i < placed.length; i += 1) if (placed[i] === undefined) return null

mutants.mutant: an array constructor's named arguments are not mapped
a colour built-in's named arguments are not mapped
